lead: A mechanical sweep over the `.nvst` corpus has to treat each `--SECTION--` as its own program.
body: A whole-file answer to "is this name used elsewhere" keeps one section's `$i` in the old spelling because a `--FILE <path>--` or `--CLEAN--` program in the same case mentions the same name, and licenses an edit in one section on the strength of a use in another. Split on `^--[A-Z]` and scope both the backward search for the declaration (a stacked run of declarations is the common shape, so not the previous line only) and the "used elsewhere" check to the enclosing section.
